vf-button: Component wrapper for a button element.
vf-checkbox: Component wrapper for a single checkbox element.
vf-checkboxes: Component wrapper for a checkbox group element.
vf-content: Content area within a static or container element.
vf-drop-target: Drop target area for file drag-and-drop uploads.
vf-field: Wrapper around the input field area of an element.
vf-file: Component wrapper for a file upload element.
vf-file-name: File name display text inside a file item.
vf-file-remove: Remove button for a single uploaded file.
vf-form-error: Single error item within the form-level error list.
vf-form-errors-wrapper: Wrapper around the form-level error message list.
vf-form-message: Single message item within the form-level message list.
vf-form-messages-wrapper: Wrapper around the form-level message list.
vf-list: Component wrapper for a repeatable list element.
vf-matrix: Component wrapper for a matrix element.
vf-message: Single informational message item within an element.
vf-radio: Component wrapper for a single radio element.
vf-radios: Component wrapper for a radio group element.
vf-select: Component wrapper for a select element.
vf-text: Component wrapper for a text input element.
vf-textarea: Component wrapper for a textarea element.
